title: Google takes down botnet on 1.3 million Android TV boxes
excerpt: Google cuts ties with the firm responsible for a hidden botnet operating across millions of Android TV devices.
body_html:
Google has taken action to dismantle a large botnet that was operating secretly across 1.3 million Android TV boxes. As part of this operation, Google severed its business connections with the company that was behind the botnet campaign.

The illicit network utilized infected streaming hardware without the knowledge of the device owners. Google's intervention aims to neutralize the threat posed by this infrastructure and prevent further unauthorized activity on the affected systems.
